trailer/concept.prompt: Genre: epic cinematic concept trailer music, hybrid orchestra with shimmering analog synths and a wordless choir pad. BPM: 96. Key: D minor rising to F major. Instrumental only, no vocals singing words. A seventy-second trailer cue for a vast fantasy world made of many floating lands stitched together by light. Structure: opens in near silence with a lone soft synth tone and distant shimmering bells in deep space for eight seconds; a gentle piano and string motif enters as something is created; a slow rising swell of strings and choir builds through a ritual of light to a first big orchestral hit at about 26 seconds; then driving low strings, taiko drums and pulsing synths carry a montage of worlds at full energy with a soaring heroic brass theme; the biggest climax at about 56 seconds as the camera pulls back over the whole world; ends on one final ringing hit and a long shimmering tail. Production: modern Hollywood trailer mix, wide stereo, deep low end, big hall reverb, clean punchy hits.
